name: Nordleda (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nordleda (a white chevron between stars on red above green waves).
history: Municipal flag of Nordleda; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Nordleda arms — chevron, stars and waves
